articles.nri_angle: Honor's battery-first smartphones could appeal to price-conscious Indian diaspora consumers, particularly as Chinese brands expand into markets like India, Southeast Asia, and the Middle East where long battery life is a top purchasing priority.

articles.title: AI Set to Extend Fossil Fuel Dominance, Research Warns — And Not Because of Data Centers
